description: The bounds of an Alumni merge's written reason (D55), in CODE POINTS after trimming - never UTF-16 units, so an emoji counts once on both sides. core-service enforces them (ALUMNI_MERGE_REASON_MIN / ALUMNI_MERGE_REASON_MAX in alumni-merge.errors.ts, checkMergeReason) and the admin page counts the same way before sending (alumniReasonState in frontend/src/lib/profile/alumniMerge.ts). Each side's test asserts its constants and its verdict on every case below, so the two cannot drift apart.
